scope: MEM-IMPACT-14 warm synthetic full Mailbox.impact CPU audit, exact outputs and freshness/provenance/ACK preservation; no model KV/QA/TTFT claim
timing: Six criteria and thresholds frozen in plan-v2.md before implementation/producer; this schema projection written after producer and before independent result acceptance, no changed criteria or thresholds

implementation.procedure: Independently inspect diff, exact baseline, sys.modules binding and actual full Mailbox call; verify type/density/shallow guards and no cache/writes
implementation.acceptance: No changed evidence/freshness/error/scope/ACK contract, actual source hashes bound

reference_boundary.procedure: Review 250 independent ancestor oracle cases, 10 complete fixture differentials, permanent normal/O tests; add independent boundaries/custom operations/public checks
reference_boundary.acceptance: Exact full outputs and nonmutation, unrelated exclusion and all applicable independent checks pass

data_integrity.procedure: Recompute baseline/current/harness/fixture/plan/input hashes, all 21 pairs per 10 cases and logical-state invariants
data_integrity.acceptance: No mixed/missing/cherry-picked pairs, legitimate original module baseline and actual independent raw retained

numerical_sanity.procedure: Recompute every median/reduction from positive finite ns, separate traced peak bytes
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Numbers and units agree, no claim that full-entry peak isolates extra adjacency allocation

measurement_validity.procedure: Inspect full entry timing, out-of-clock module binding/setup/oracle, three warmup pairs,21alternatingpairs, separate allocation measurements and serial actors
measurement_validity.acceptance: Producer AND independent: chain512 reduction>=25%,shared256>=15%,each other case regression<=15%; no model or universal speed claim

reproducibility.procedure: Independent review plus PYTHONHASHSEED=14 21pair replay and own bounded cases; full regression and Reader before release
reproducibility.acceptance: Both actor frozen gates and applicable checks pass; preserve failures/host noise/scope and remaining gaps
